t: Founded in 618, the Tang Dynasty pushed Chinese power deep into Central Asia and made Chang'an one of the world's great cities.
Its law code, government model and Buddhist culture were adopted by Japan, Korea and Vietnam and shaped East Asia for centuries.
The An Lushan Rebellion left power with regional generals; the Huang Chao uprising finished it and a warlord deposed the last emperor in 907.
dyk: The Diamond Sutra of 868, found at Dunhuang, is the oldest surviving dated printed book in the world.
ev: Li Yuan proclaims the Tang Dynasty after seizing Chang'an from the collapsing Sui
Li Shimin kills his brothers at the Xuanwu Gate and becomes Emperor Taizong
The Tang destroy the Eastern Turkic Khaganate; Taizong is hailed as Heavenly Khagan
Wu Zetian proclaims her own Zhou dynasty, interrupting Tang rule until 705
Abbasid forces defeat Gao Xianzhi's Tang army at the Battle of Talas
An Lushan rebels, capturing Luoyang and Chang'an and forcing Xuanzong to flee
Zhu Wen deposes the last Tang emperor and founds the Later Liang
